calls.title: MC Sonae<>GrowthBook - Implementation Discussion
calls.summary: The meeting was centered on the implementation and integration planning for GrowthBook, focusing on the setup of SDK, data connections, and environment management to meet an upcoming deadline. A developer session was agreed upon to ensure smooth SDK integration and event tracking, led by Chris Sanders. Detailed explanations on SDK data flow and tracking callbacks were provided, emphasizing precise targeting for experiments. The team also discussed integrating with data warehouses via SQL, utilizing flexible ingestion methods. User access management was highlighted, with plans for SSO and centralized administrative controls. Finally, the importance of experimentation to identify impactful features was framed by Chris Sanders, who stressed the need for AA testing to validate data accuracy.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, SDK integration, A/B testing, data warehouse, single sign-on, feature flags
